## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #170, exact head `a0967ab023606364e6e2ec5a41db5f6304315f16`.

Reviewed `060ef06..a0967ab` and the directly dependent prune entry paths. S170-001 is closed **by removing Linux support**, not by repairing the procfs assumptions. No new high-confidence exploitable security vulnerability was identified.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No new vulnerability identified | - |

### Closure evidence

The procfs implementation is deleted. The CLI rejects non-macOS pruning with exit 2 before tool resolution or launches (`harness/scripts/pr-freeze.ts:890-895`). Direct `prune` rejects the real/default non-macOS platform before inventory or deletion (`668-675`).

The exported function retains an explicit platform parameter for trusted direct callers/tests; a caller can inject darwin there. The CLI exposes no corresponding override. This is not an unconditional guarantee for arbitrary trusted in-process parameter injection.

Strict macOS lsof exit/stderr/malformed/empty-output checks remain (`pr-freeze.ts:613-639`). Existing absolute launch paths, discrete argv, gh/seat validation, canonical-path matching, strict review-name/detached-HEAD checks and non-forced Git removal remain unchanged.

Test source retains a positive mocked removal and unsupported-platform rejection with zero runner commands (`harness/scripts/pr-freeze.test.ts:594-624,741-749`). CLI refusal itself was source-verified, not independently executed here.

### Supported scope and limitations

`AGENTS.md:194-197`, `justfile:214-216`, script comments (`pr-freeze.ts:478-484`) and the PR Known limits now describe macOS and this user's processes only. Other-user occupancy remains unseen; this is not machine-wide occupancy protection. Snapshot-to-deletion races also remain: canonical path comparisons do not lock a worktree against later use.

Plain freeze and worktree creation retain their cross-platform behavior. No new C19/C21 disclosure was identified in the delta.

### Proof

GitHub metadata and the independent remote pull ref agree on the full reviewed SHA; GitHub reports CLEAN. CI run `42432231265` and latest successful Delivers run `42432231398` both identify this exact SHA and success; the earlier cancelled Delivers run is superseded.

No local builds, tests, process probes, prune execution, credential reads, deletions or mutations were performed.
